items.summary: Disposition: evidence_needed. Do not claim fleet security clearance or production readiness. Fleet-doctor and operations sweeps have no results; authentication boundaries, secrets handling, container isolation, release controls, dependency provenance, TLS validation, data exposure, incident monitoring, and disclosure readiness are not sufficiently evidenced. Compliance shows 18 failures and 6 unknowns, while no concrete security incident or expiring-TLS signal is recorded. Recommendation: retain private launch and security-sensitive release gates; permit ordinary reversible growth only when it adds no credentials, permissions, dependencies, configuration, tracking, or cross-site behavior. Reassess after an authorized evidence bundle documents each control and owner.

items.title: Maintain evidence-needed fleet security disposition and release gates
